Reward safeguards

Two-key rewards grant two new keys after you spent the opening key. Random pools contain only selected safe items. Spawn eggs exclude bosses and dangerous summons. Simply Swords pools distinguish ordinary diamond-tier weapons from selected Unique weapons.

Timed flight potions last 10 or 60 minutes, keep their expiry through relogging, and provide slow falling when flight ends. The relic consumable adds one level to each equipped eligible Relics item and is kept if none qualify. Infinite storage cells are empty. Wireless terminals still require a working bound network. Matching Ender Storage chests use the same default frequency.

Vote keys are earned by voting. They are not sold in the supporter store.
